_comment: Kyty-003: Per-game hack flags. Override or add to the hardcoded map in src/loader/hack_features.cpp. Format: "CUSA_ID": ["HackName1", "HackName2"]. Available hacks: DepthDisable, ComputeDisable, DisableAsyncCompute, DisableSRGB, DisableFMV, SkipUnknownTiling, ForceDepthRangeRestricted, UseColorImageForComparison, SkipShaderAssert, ImageLoadNoReload, MemoryBound, ForcePs4ProMode, ForceDevKitMode, BloodborneAudioFix, Pm4Type0Fix
_example_Sifu: PPSA01491 is hardcoded to DisableAsyncCompute+ForceDepthRangeRestricted. To ADD SkipShaderAssert without removing the hardcoded hacks, add the entry below — overrides are OR'd with the hardcoded map.
_bloodborne: Bloodborne (CUSA00900/CUSA00231/CUSA03173) is hardcoded with BloodborneAudioFix+Pm4Type0Fix+MemoryBound. Add overrides below to enable additional hacks without removing the hardcoded ones.
